name: Classic: Grimfang Moot
desc: Moot deck. VP via sept: Silver Record, Winter Wolf, Legendary Leadership, Caern Building, Umbral Quest. Combat deck = escape only. Grimfang = voting lynchpin. No anti-Wyrm.

combat_notes.philosophy: ESCAPE ONLY. Your combat deck exists to END combats, not to win them. You have 7 escape routes. Always have a suitable escape in hand.
combat_notes.who_fights: Flame Spirits are good alphas. Never use voting characters in combat if avoidable.
combat_notes.run_like_hell: Voting characters (Grimfang, Storm-Chaser) should NOT use Run Like Hell. Prey and allies can.
combat_notes.spirit_drain: Spirit Drain is there primarily to DENY a kill, not to be aggressive.

moot_proposal_priorities.desc: Winter Wolf (Rn:6) — Remove Garou Rn≥6 + 6VP. With Legendary Leadership = 12VP.
Skindancer (Rn:6) — Devastates Gaia decks. Transform Garou into Enemy.
Tribal War (Rn:6) — GREAT opening moot. Forces same-tribe opponents to fight.
The Stolen Wolf (Rn:6) — Reverts Garou form. Situational.
The Litany's Guidance (Rn:7) — Denies VP from Gaia enemies.

gift_priorities.desc: Falcon (Pack Totem) — +1 Renown per pack member for moot votes. CRITICAL.
Aegis (Gn:6) — +2 Health on Grimfang (Hl:3→5) +2 Renown moot. Vital for survival.
Spirit Drain (Gn:8) — PRIMARY use: deny opponent a kill. Secondary: remove spirit.

equipment_assignments.desc: The Silver Crown (+6 Renown moot, +6 Gn). Absolute priority on Grimfang.
Elder Stone (+3 Gn). Backup for Grimfang or second copy.

_default.escape_priority: ALWAYS escape. Never attack unless forced and no escape available.

escape_order.desc: Flee combat — USE ONLY for prey/allies, NOT voting chars
Leave combat between rounds — escape route
Redirect mortal wound — save key character

grimfang.special: NEVER fight. Always escape. Grimfang is the voting lynchpin — losing him = losing the game.

old_storm-chaser.special: Card drawer. Escape always. Storm-Chaser exists to draw cards, not fight.

ivan_korda.special: Sacrificial. Can be sent on Umbral Quest or sacrificed to save others.

diem.special: Sacrificial. Can be sacrificed without much impact.

flame_spirit.special: ALPHA STRIKER. Use Flame Spirits as alpha attack. They are expendable.

card_play_priority.desc: Equipment FIRST (voting power), then Caerns, then Allies (TV Reporters, Flame Spirits).

umbra_strategy.desc: Yuri Tvarivich enters Umbra via Past Life. NEVER put Grimfang or Storm-Chaser at risk.

target_priority.desc: DO NOT initiate combat. Let opponents come to you. Your combat deck is escape-only.

redraw_rules.desc: Keep voting pieces. Discard combat cards — you only need enough escapes.
